site.tagline: A knowledge garden with a community attached. Ideas start as a spoken thought and grow, revision by revision, into something worth sharing.

roleHints.member: Reads everything public and takes part in discussions.
roleHints.editor: Writes and publishes notes and articles.
roleHints.moderator: Keeps discussions healthy and lets new members in.

auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A few unrelated words make a strong one.
auth.unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again in a minute.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.linkSentBody: If {email} has an account here, a sign-in link is on its way. It works for 15 minutes.
signIn.inviteOnly: Joining {site} takes an invitation from a member.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.nameHint: Shown next to what you write. You can change it later.
signUp.approvalNote: New accounts are reviewed before they can take part. You can browse while you wait.
signUp.passkeyLater: You can add a passkey from your account page once you’re in.
signUp.inviteOnlyBody: Joining {site} takes an invitation. Ask a member to send you one.

invite.title: Join {site}
invite.useBoundEmail: Sign up with the address this invitation was sent to.
invite.signedInAs: You’re signed in as {email}. Sign out to accept this invitation with a new account.
invite.invalidBody: It has expired, was already used, or was withdrawn. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.body: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to finish setting up your account.
verify.failed: That confirmation link has expired or was already used. Send a new one.
verify.signedOut: Sign in, then confirm your email from here.
verify.doneBody: Your address is confirmed and your account is ready.

reset.requestBody: Enter your email and we’ll send a link to choose a new password.
reset.sentBody: If {email} has an account, a reset link is on its way. It works for one hour.
reset.noMail: This site can’t send email yet, so passwords can’t be reset here. Ask the site owner for a reset link.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.doneBody: Sign in with your new password. Your other devices were signed out.
reset.invalid: This reset link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

account.title: Your account
account.unverifiedBody: Until your address is confirmed, your account can only read.
account.pendingBody: An owner or moderator will review your account. You can browse in the meantime.

profile.title: Profile
profile.languageHint: Emails from this site use this language.

password.title: Password
password.none: You sign in without a password, with a passkey, GitHub or an email link.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.lead: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password.
passkeys.empty: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without typing a password.
passkeys.removeBody: You won’t be able to sign in with it any more. Other passkeys and sign-in methods keep working.

settings.descriptionHint: Shown on the home page and in search results.
settings.languageHint: Used for email when a member hasn’t picked a language.
settings.accessLead: Who can create an account, and how members sign in.

invite.label: Invitation only
invite.description: People join through an invitation link.

approval.label: Anyone can ask to join
approval.description: New accounts wait for an owner or moderator to approve them.

open.label: Anyone can join
open.description: New accounts can take part once their email is confirmed.

settings.passwordHint: Sign in with email and password.
settings.magicLinkHint: Sign in with a one-time link sent by email.
settings.magicLinkNoMail: Needs email to be set up below.
settings.staleTitle: Sign in again to change this
settings.staleBody: Changes to who can join, sign-in and email need a sign-in from the last 10 minutes.

mail.title: Email
mail.lead: How this site sends invitations, sign-in links and password resets.

none.label: Don’t send email
none.description: Invitations are shared as links; email sign-in and password resets are off.

log.label: Server log
log.description: Writes each email to the server log instead of sending it. For development.

smtp.label: SMTP
smtp.description: Any mail provider that offers SMTP.

aliyun-dm.label: Alibaba Cloud DirectMail
aliyun-dm.description: Sends through the DirectMail API with an AccessKey.

from.label: Sender address
from.hint: Must be a sender your provider has verified.

replyTo.label: Reply-to address
replyTo.hint: Where replies go if not to the sender.

port.label: Port
port.hint: Usually 465 with TLS, or 587 with STARTTLS.

secure.label: Connect with TLS
secure.hint: Turn off for port 587; the connection is upgraded with STARTTLS.

username.label: Username
username.hint: Leave empty if the server doesn’t need one.

accessKeyId.label: AccessKey ID
accessKeyId.hint: Use a RAM user that can only send mail.

mail.secretHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
mail.secretKeptHint: Stored encrypted. Leave empty to keep the saved one.
mail.allowListTitle: Mail goes to listed addresses only
mail.allowListBody: This server only delivers to: {list}. Other recipients are skipped.
mail.resetBody: The settings saved here are deleted, and email goes out the way the server environment is set up.

invites.title: Invitations
invites.createLead: Send an invitation to join {site}. It works once and expires in 7 days.
invites.emailHint: We’ll email the invitation, and only this address can use it.
invites.emailHintNoMail: Only this address can use the invitation. This site can’t send email, so share the link yourself.
invites.shareLink: Anyone with this link can join once. Share it privately.
invites.revokeBody: The link stops working right away.

members.title: Members
members.waiting: One person is waiting for approval. | {count} people are waiting for approval.
members.suspendBody: They’re signed out everywhere and can’t sign in until restored. Nothing they wrote is deleted.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again, and if it keeps happening, tell the site owner.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.forbidden: Your account isn’t allowed to do this.
errors.bad_origin: This request didn’t come from this site. Reload the page and try again.
errors.session_not_fresh: For your security, sign in again to change this.
errors.session_expired: For your security, sign in again to change this.
errors.invalid_email_or_password: That email and password don’t match an account.
errors.user_already_exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.user_already_exists_use_another_email: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.email_taken: Someone with this email already has an account.
errors.email_not_verified: Confirm your email first. Check your inbox for the link.
errors.invitation_required: Joining this site takes an invitation.
errors.invitation_invalid: This invitation has expired or was already used.
errors.invitation_email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address. Sign up with the invited address; you can link a GitHub account with another address from your account page afterwards.
errors.owner_exists: This site already has an owner.
errors.email_unverifiable: This site can’t send email, so it can’t confirm your address. Sign up with GitHub or ask for an invitation sent to your email.
errors.password_disabled: Password sign-in is turned off on this site.
errors.magic_link_disabled: Email sign-in links aren’t available on this site.
errors.invalid_token: This link has expired or was already used.
errors.token_expired: This link has expired. Request a new one.
errors.expired_token: This link has expired. Request a new one.
errors.unable_to_create_user: Your account couldn’t be created. Joining this site may take an invitation.
errors.account_already_linked_to_different_user: That GitHub account is already connected to someone else here.
errors.failed_to_unlink_last_account: This is your only way to sign in, so it can’t be disconnected.
errors.recipient_not_allowed: This server only delivers mail to the addresses in CAIRN_MAIL_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS, and yours isn’t one of them.
errors.mail_failed: The email couldn’t be sent. Check the email settings and the server log.
